fixes.explanation: That's the one, friend. Numbers 3:4 says Nadab and Abihu "died in the presence of the LORD when they offered unauthorized fire before the LORD in the Wilderness of Sinai." I think this one hurts. The same verse adds that they had no sons, so only Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests during Aaron's lifetime.

That's it, friend. Moses, Aaron and Aaron's sons camp on the east, toward the sunrise. Numbers 3:38 says they were to "…perform the duties of the sanctuary as a service on behalf of the Israelites…" So the Israelites are who that service is for. The same verse says any outsider who approached the sanctuary was to be put to death.

True, friend. The LORD tells Moses, "You are to take the Levites for Me—I am the LORD—in place of all the firstborn of Israel, and the livestock of the Levites in place of all the firstborn of the livestock of the Israelites." (Numbers 3:41). So the animals are part of the instruction, right alongside the people. The Levites' livestock take the place of the Israelites' firstborn livestock.

Sons, that's the one. The LORD says, "Give the money to Aaron and his sons…" (Numbers 3:48). So the money goes to Aaron and his sons together. Moses collects it, then hands it over, just as Numbers 3:51 says.
